subject: JC IMP-2: friendly error on revoked/expired Gmail token
description: While the OAuth app is in Testing mode Google revokes the gmail.readonly refresh token ~weekly. _load_credentials calls creds.refresh() with no handling -> a RefreshError surfaces opaquely on intake-poll/daily. Add GmailAuthError + a clear guidance message ('re-run intake-auth'); wrap the refresh; make cmd_intake_poll degrade to a SystemExit with guidance (daily's intake stage already catches SystemExit and continues). Build -> Nancy -> Chris -> commit.
